description: Find National Park Service and Forest Service campgrounds by name, id, park or national forest (e.g. "Yosemite", "Shasta-Trinity"), or state ("CO", "Colorado"), with whether each is open today and its booking link. Returns ids for campgrounds_get_status. NPS campgrounds are open or closed by the park's published schedule; Forest Service ones by the status each forest lists (refreshed every 6 hours). "not listed" means the forest gives no status: unknown, not closed.

query.description: Name, id, park, forest or state, case-insensitive

name: campgrounds_search
title: Search campgrounds
